verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ הַֽלְלוּ־אֵ֥ל בְּקָדְשֹׁ֑ו הֽ͏ַ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: هَلِّلُويَا. سَبِّحُوا ٱللهَ فِي قُدْسِهِ. سَبِّحُوهُ فِي فَلَكِ قُوَّتِهِ.
verses.en: Hallelujah. Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in the firmament of His power.
verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.web: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

verses.ar: سَبِّحُوهُ عَلَى قُوَّاتِهِ. سَبِّحُوهُ حَسَبَ كَثْرَةِ عَظَمَتِهِ.
verses.en: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to His abundant greatness.
verses.kjv: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.web: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

verses.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֵ֣קַע שֹׁופָ֑ר הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּנֵ֣בֶל וְכִנֹּֽור׃
verses.ar: سَبِّحُوهُ بِصَوْتِ ٱلصُّورِ. سَبِّحُوهُ بِرَبَابٍ وَعُودٍ.
verses.en: Praise Him with the blast of the horn; praise Him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.kjv: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.web: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

verses.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְתֹ֣ף וּמָחֹ֑ול הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּמִנִּ֥ים וְעוּגָֽב׃
verses.ar: سَبِّحُوهُ بِدُفٍّ وَرَقْصٍ. سَبِّحُوهُ بِأَوْتَارٍ وَمِزْمَارٍ.
verses.en: Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; praise Him with stringed instruments and the pipe.
verses.kjv: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.web: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

verses.ar: سَبِّحُوهُ بِصُنُوجِ ٱلتَّصْوِيتِ. سَبِّحُوهُ بِصُنُوجِ ٱلْهُتَافِ.
verses.en: Praise Him with the loud-sounding cymbals; praise Him with the clanging cymbals.
verses.kjv: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.web: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

verses.en: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Hallelujah.
verses.kjv: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.web: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
